challenged_statement: The primary r14 report used h*sqrt(e)/(2||C^T Z||) in the TT* conditional step and hence stated the half-Holder constant sqrt(e) pi^(1/4).
correction: If two outputs lie in an interval of length h then their difference lies in [-h,h]. Since the coefficient is 2 C^T Z, the induced interval for (C^T Z)^T V has length h, giving h*sqrt(e)/||C^T Z||. The corrected theorem is P(T in K)<=sqrt(2e) pi^(1/4) h^(1/2)(s1s2)^(-1/4).
secondary_proof_correction: From s1+s2>tau/2 and s2>=tau/16 one cannot always infer s1>7tau/16. The needed product lower bound s1s2>7tau^2/256 remains true by splitting s2 in [tau/16,tau/4] and s2>=tau/4. In the complementary s2<tau/16 branch, s1>7tau/16 is valid.
impact: The exponent 1/2, all hypotheses, and QFORM-HIGH-SCHUR-OFFDIAG-PAID-v1 remain valid. At tau=3/10 the corrected explicit constant is 13.9371688286<13.938 rather than 9.856.
